title: 近300万青年：无学可上无工可做，欧洲边界何去何从？
speaker: Maryam Charity

segments.en: So most of those who have made it on their own and also the kind of the political organization
segments.zh: 大多数靠自己成功的人，以及背后的政治组织

segments.en: or state institution being the sort of centrally behind it is not quite founded.
segments.zh: 或国家机构作为核心支持，这种模式并不稳固。

segments.en: Let me ask you lastly just about the legacy of this event.
segments.zh: 最后我想问您，这一事件的影响是什么？

segments.en: So as you've been saying, there have been other mass crossings before, nothing of this scale or magnitude.
segments.zh: 正如您所说，此前也有大规模越境，但从未达到如此规模。

segments.en: And we've seen the way that many politicians around the world have kind of focused on this as some sort of rally and cry.
segments.zh: 我们看到全球许多政客将此视为某种动员口号。

segments.en: Do you think that this will prevent other efforts like this in the future given the amount of death that we saw as a result of this, the amount of injury
segments.zh: 鉴于此次事件造成的伤亡，您认为这会阻止未来类似行动吗？

segments.en: or is this port 10, do you think more attempts at kind of mass crossings like this in the future?
segments.zh: 还是说，未来会有更多类似的大规模越境尝试？

segments.en: I think there are no guarantees that, you know, attempts of maybe not of this scale but attempts to cross irregularly to Sota or many of that matter won't happen
segments.zh: 我认为无法保证未来不会发生类似尝试，或许规模不同，但非法越境仍会出现。

segments.en: because as long as you have the same driving forces or driving factors in terms of an employment, in terms of, you know,
segments.zh: 因为只要存在同样的驱动力，比如就业方面的问题，

segments.en: like close to 3 million Moroccans who are not in employment education, young Moroccans in education or training, you know, the aspiration is still there.
segments.zh: 比如近300万摩洛哥青年既未就业也未接受教育或培训，他们的渴望依然存在。

segments.en: To get a better future, to get a better job for themselves and their families.
segments.zh: 他们渴望更好的未来，为自己和家人找到更好的工作。

segments.en: So that's probably, I think, all the, you know, the floating barriers on all of that are not going to dis raid these young people or, yeah, to try and cross irregularly
segments.zh: 所以我认为，那些流动的障碍不会打消这些年轻人非法越境的念头。

segments.en: as long as there is no legal pathway for them to go.
segments.zh: 只要没有合法的途径，他们就会继续尝试。

segments.en: And the second thing, what I've noticed in terms of social media activity following the crossing is that there are two different types of new messaging going around.
segments.zh: 其次，我注意到越境事件后社交媒体上出现了两类新的信息。

segments.en: The first one is around those who've made it to Sota, narrating their experience, narrating how actually, now that they've made it, probably it's not worth it, you know,
segments.zh: 第一类是成功抵达的人分享经历，讲述抵达后可能并不值得。

segments.en: like they weren't able to eat for days, they weren't able to access any help.
segments.zh: 比如几天没吃饭，得不到任何帮助。
